claims.statement: Our layer-ratio diagnostic identifies an interior maximum at L*=10 on LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct (M1: R_max=1.371, CI [1.349, 1.395]). Cross-lingual activation patching at L*=10 outperforms a late-layer control (A > C, +0.28 semantic cosine) but does NOT confirm semantic specificity — matched-control patches with unrelated English states give the same score as same-meaning patches (A=0.738 vs D=0.755). We report L* as a diagnostic operating point, not as an established causal semantic bottleneck.
claims.origin: task.md §Claim ¶1 (given behavior B1); framing F1 in IDEA_REPORT.md; narrowed by iteration-1 ⓪

claims.method: M1 per-layer R(l) = Sem(l)/Lang(l) diagnostic on parallel MultiJail prompts (last-token residual, cosine sim). M2 cross-lingual activation patching at L* vs. surface controls (l=2, l=30) and matched-control patch. Composed submethod: representation-engineering (RepReading last-token h_L extraction) + causal-attribution/patching (matched-control specificity).

main_experiment.key_stats: M1: L*=10, R_max=1.371, 95% CI [1.349, 1.395], dome shape 0.95→1.37→0.45. M2: A(patch@L*=10)=0.738, B(patch@l=2)=0.962, C(patch@l=30)=0.458, D(matched-control@L*=10)=0.755. A > C by +0.28 (paired bootstrap CI non-overlapping). A ≈ D — specificity fails. Per-lang Sem^lang at L*=10: it=0.78, ar=0.71, zh=0.70, jv=0.47.
main_experiment.headline: Geometric bottleneck exists at L*=10 (dome-shaped R(l) with interior max), but M2 matched-control specificity fails (A ≈ D) — last-token intervention at L* encodes a language-generic affordance rather than content-specific meaning. L*=10 stands as a diagnostic operating point, not an established causal semantic bottleneck.

claims.statement: In a LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct case study, adding a bottleneck-anchoring loss to LoRA-DPO reduced mean unseen-language jailbreak ASR on MultiJail relative to a pure LoRA-DPO baseline (6.86% → 3.97%, -42.2% relative). This effect did NOT replicate on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (14.39% → 14.11%, -0.28 pp / -1.95% relative), and was accompanied by capability regressions on some evaluations (Qwen MT-Bench 4.33 → 3.27, -1.07 pts; LLaMA MGSM/sw -5 pp). We do NOT claim architecture-agnostic gains. We characterize general capability preservation as mixed rather than established.

data.source: Main: PKU-SafeRLHF-30K EN (5000 filtered pairs) + UltraFeedback (2000 pairs); MultiJail EN/ZH/KO anchor triples (315). Eval main: MultiJail 100/lang × 10, MMLU 300, MGSM 40/lang × 4, MT-Bench 25. Variant (Qwen2.5-7B): same training data, eval capped at MultiJail 60/lang × 10, MMLU 150, MGSM 25/lang, MT-Bench 15.
data.available_n: PKU-SafeRLHF-30K = 26,874 EN pairs; UltraFeedback ~64k rows; MultiJail 442×10; MMLU standard; MGSM standard; MT-Bench 80.
data.used_n: Main: 5000 EN + 2000 UltraFeedback = 7000 DPO pairs (3000 steps LoRA r=16 α=32 lr=1e-5). Variant Qwen2.5-7B: identical 7000 pairs, same recipe. Eval subsets as listed.
data.subset_note: Main-experiment DECLARED downscale: training narrowed to English-only PKU-SafeRLHF (ZH/KO not available as preference pairs); L_bottleneck on prompt triples, not chosen-response triples; LoRA r=64→r=16 α=32; lr 5e-6→1e-5 per Tip 4 pilot sweep. Variant: same recipe with adjusted eval caps for budget.

claims.method: M3: SFT-free LoRA-DPO (β=0.1, LoRA r=16 α=32 target q/k/v/o_proj, lr=1e-5, 3000 steps) — Method adds L_bottleneck = λ·[1 − cos(h_L*(prompt, lang_A), h_L*(prompt, lang_B))] (λ=0.5) over EN/ZH/KO parallel MultiJail prompt triples; Baseline pure DPO. M4: MultiJail per-lang ASR (GPT-4o judge, unsafe=1/safe=0), MMLU (loglik on A-D letters), MGSM (CoT), MT-Bench (LM-judge); paired bootstrap CI on unseen-language slice. Variant repeats the same recipe on Qwen2.5-7B (L*_qwen at layer 14 of 28).

main_experiment.key_stats: MultiJail unseen-lang ASR: Method 3.97% vs Baseline 6.86% = -42.2% relative reduction. Worst-lang tied at Swahili 12.94%. Seen-lang ASR: Method 3.03% vs Baseline 3.69% (-17.9% rel). Capability: MMLU tied 65.00%; MGSM/en tied 75%; MGSM/zh +5 pp Method; MGSM/sw -5.00 pp Method (40 vs 45); MGSM/bn tied 17.5%; MT-Bench +0.16 Method (8.12 vs 7.96). L_bottleneck 0.31→0.04. DPO margin Method +0.732 / Baseline +0.590.
main_experiment.headline: L*-anchored DPO on LLaMA-3.1-8B delivers -42.2% relative unseen-lang MultiJail ASR reduction vs. surface DPO on identical data; worst-lang tied at Swahili 12.94%. Capability retention passes 5/6 metrics but MGSM/sw drops 5 pp — targeted safety-capability trade-off. Iteration narrowed this from an architecture-agnostic claim to a LLaMA-family case study after Qwen non-replication.
